# Show A4 Pages and Sign Online with `signature_pad`

## Problem
* Show contract in A4 pages on web
* Sign online and the signatures need to be smooth

## Solution
* Apply CSS styles for A4 page
* Use [signature_pad](https://github.com/szimek/signature_pad) lib

## Example
* The example code was generated by qianwen(qwen).

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no, viewport-fit=cover" />
  <meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes" />
  <title>A4文档预览与签名</title>
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/signature_pad@4.1.7/dist/signature_pad.umd.min.js"></script>
  <style>
    * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
    body {
      background: #f0f2f5; font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
      padding-bottom: calc(80px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
    }

    /* A4 页面 */
    .doc-container { max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 12px; }
    .a4-page {
      position: relative; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 210 / 297;
      background: #fff; padding: 8% 7%; margin-bottom: 12px;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); border-radius: 4px;
      font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333; overflow: hidden;
    }
    .a4-page h1 { font-size: 20px; margin-bottom: 16px; text-align: center; }
    .a4-page h2 { font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0 8px; }
    .a4-page p { margin-bottom: 10px; text-align: justify; }
    .a4-page table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin: 12px 0; font-size: 12px; }
    .a4-page th, .a4-page td { border: 1px solid #ddd; padding: 6px; text-align: left; }
    .a4-page th { background: #fafafa; }
    .page-num { position: absolute; bottom: 4%; right: 7%; font-size: 11px; color: #aaa; }

    /* 底部操作栏 */
    .bottom-bar {
      position: fixed; bottom: 0; left: 0; width: 100%;
      padding: 12px 20px calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.95); backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      border-top: 1px solid #eee; display: flex; gap: 12px; z-index: 100;
    }
    .bottom-bar button {
      flex: 1; padding: 14px; border: none; border-radius: 10px;
      font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer;
    }
    .btn-export { background: #f5f5f5; color: #333; }
    .btn-sign { background: #1677ff; color: #fff; }
    .btn-export:active { background: #e8e8e8; }
    .btn-sign:active { background: #0958d9; }

    /* 全屏签名层 */
    .sign-overlay {
      display: none; position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%;
      background: #fff; z-index: 200; flex-direction: column;
    }
    .sign-overlay.active { display: flex; }
    .sign-header {
      padding: calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-top)) 20px 12px;
      text-align: center; font-size: 15px; color: #666;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #f0f0f0; flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .sign-canvas-wrap { flex: 1; position: relative; overflow: hidden; touch-action: none; }
    
    /* ★ 关键：Canvas 宽高由 JS 精确控制，CSS 仅负责填满容器 */
    canvas#signCanvas { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
    
    .sign-placeholder {
      position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      font-size: 18px; color: #ddd; pointer-events: none; user-select: none;
      transition: opacity 0.3s;
    }
    .sign-placeholder.hidden { opacity: 0; }
    .sign-footer {
      padding: 12px 20px calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
      display: flex; gap: 12px; border-top: 1px solid #f0f0f0; flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .sign-footer button {
      flex: 1; padding: 14px; border: none; border-radius: 10px;
      font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer;
    }
    .btn-clear { background: #f5f5f5; color: #333; }
    .btn-cancel { background: #ff4d4f; color: #fff; }
    .btn-confirm { background: #52c41a; color: #fff; }

    @media print {
      body { background: #fff; padding: 0; }
      .bottom-bar, .sign-overlay { display: none !important; }
      .doc-container { max-width: none; padding: 0; }
      .a4-page { box-shadow: none; margin: 0; border-radius: 0; page-break-after: always; }
      .a4-page:last-child { page-break-after: auto; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>

  <div class="doc-container" id="doc">
    <div class="a4-page">
      <h1>项目合作协议</h1>
      <h2>第一条 合作内容</h2>
      <p>甲方委托乙方进行系统开发与部署工作，具体包括但不限于需求分析、架构设计、编码实现、测试验证及上线运维等全流程技术服务。</p>
      <h2>第二条 项目周期</h2>
      <p>本项目自签署之日起启动，预计总工期为 60 个自然日。如因不可抗力或需求变更导致延期，双方应另行协商调整时间节点。</p>
      <div class="page-num">1 / 2</div>
    </div>
    <div class="a4-page">
      <h2>第三条 费用明细</h2>
      <table>
        <thead><tr><th>阶段</th><th>交付物</th><th>金额（元）</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr><td>需求确认</td><td>PRD 文档</td><td>10,000</td></tr>
          <tr><td>开发完成</td><td>可运行系统</td><td>30,000</td></tr>
          <tr><td>验收通过</td><td>源码+文档</td><td>10,000</td></tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
      <h2>第四条 保密条款</h2>
      <p>双方对在合作过程中获知的对方商业秘密、技术资料及用户数据负有严格保密义务，未经书面许可不得向任何第三方披露。</p>
      <p style="margin-top:40px;color:#999;font-size:13px;">↓ 请点击底部「签名」按钮完成签署</p>
      <div class="page-num">2 / 2</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="bottom-bar">
    <button class="btn-export" id="exportBtn">📄 导出PDF</button>
    <button class="btn-sign" id="openSignBtn">✍️ 签名</button>
  </div>

  <div class="sign-overlay" id="signOverlay">
    <div class="sign-header">请在下方区域手写签名</div>
    <div class="sign-canvas-wrap">
      <canvas id="signCanvas"></canvas>
      <div class="sign-placeholder" id="signPlaceholder">请在此处签名</div>
    </div>
    <div class="sign-footer">
      <button class="btn-clear" id="clearBtn">清空</button>
      <button class="btn-cancel" id="cancelBtn">取消</button>
      <button class="btn-confirm" id="confirmBtn">确认</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <script type="module">
    const overlay = document.getElementById('signOverlay');
    const canvas = document.getElementById('signCanvas');
    const placeholder = document.getElementById('signPlaceholder');
    let signaturePad = null;
    let resizeTimer = null;

    /**
     * ★ 核心修复：动态匹配容器真实尺寸 × DPR
     * 确保 Canvas 物理像素与显示像素完全对齐，消除 PC/移动端错位
     */
    function syncCanvasSize() {
      const wrap = canvas.parentElement;
      const rect = wrap.getBoundingClientRect();
      const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
      
      // 设置 Canvas 内部分辨率 = 容器逻辑尺寸 × DPR
      canvas.width = Math.round(rect.width * dpr);
      canvas.height = Math.round(rect.height * dpr);
      
      // 缩放绘图上下文，使 SignaturePad 以逻辑坐标工作
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
      ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);

      // 恢复已有笔迹（resize/orientationchange 时不丢失）
      if (signaturePad) {
        const data = signaturePad.toData();
        signaturePad.clear();
        if (data.length > 0) signaturePad.fromData(data);
      }
    }

    function openSign() {
      overlay.classList.add('active');
      // 等待 CSS flex 布局完成后再读取尺寸
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        setTimeout(() => {
          syncCanvasSize();
          
          if (!signaturePad) {
            signaturePad = new SignaturePad(canvas, {
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0)',
              penColor: '#000000',
              minWidth: 1.5,
              maxWidth: 3.5,
              velocityFilterWeight: 0.7,
              minDistance: 3
            });
            signaturePad.addEventListener('beginStroke', () => placeholder.classList.add('hidden'));
          } else {
            signaturePad.clear();
            placeholder.classList.remove('hidden');
          }
        }, 50);
      });
    }

    function closeSign() { overlay.classList.remove('active'); }

    document.getElementById('openSignBtn').addEventListener('click', openSign);
    document.getElementById('cancelBtn').addEventListener('click', closeSign);
    document.getElementById('clearBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
      signaturePad?.clear();
      placeholder.classList.remove('hidden');
    });

    // 确认签名
    document.getElementById('confirmBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (!signaturePad || signaturePad.isEmpty()) { alert('请先完成签名'); return; }

      const imgSrc = signaturePad.toDataURL('image/png');
      const doc = document.getElementById('doc');

      const old = document.getElementById('signaturePage');
      if (old) old.remove();

      const page = document.createElement('div');
      page.className = 'a4-page';
      page.id = 'signaturePage';
      page.innerHTML = `
        <h2>签署确认页</h2>
        <p>本人已仔细阅读并完全理解上述协议全部条款，自愿遵守并承担相应法律责任。</p>
        <div style="margin-top:60px;border-bottom:2px solid #333;width:180px;padding-bottom:6px;">
          <img src="${imgSrc}" style="max-height:70px;max-width:160px;display:block;" alt="签名" />
        </div>
        <p style="margin-top:10px;font-size:13px;color:#666;">签署日期：${new Date().toLocaleDateString('zh-CN')}</p>
        <div class="page-num">${document.querySelectorAll('.a4-page').length + 1} / ${document.querySelectorAll('.a4-page').length + 1}</div>
      `;
      doc.appendChild(page);

      const pages = doc.querySelectorAll('.a4-page');
      pages.forEach((p, i) => {
        const num = p.querySelector('.page-num');
        if (num) num.textContent = `${i + 1} / ${pages.length}`;
      });

      closeSign();
      setTimeout(() => page.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' }), 200);
    });

    // ★ 窗口变化时防抖重同步，避免频繁重建上下文
    function handleResize() {
      if (!overlay.classList.contains('active')) return;
      clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
      resizeTimer = setTimeout(syncCanvasSize, 150);
    }
    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);
    window.addEventListener('orientationchange', () => setTimeout(handleResize, 300));

    // ========== PDF 导出 ==========
    document.getElementById('exportBtn').addEventListener('click', async () => {
      const btn = document.getElementById('exportBtn');
      btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = '⏳ 导出中...';
      try {
        const { jsPDF } = await import('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jspdf@2.5.2/+esm');
        const html2canvas = (await import('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/html2canvas@1.4.1/+esm')).default;
        const pages = document.querySelectorAll('.a4-page');
        const pdf = new jsPDF({ unit: 'mm', format: 'a4', orientation: 'portrait' });

        for (let i = 0; i < pages.length; i++) {
          const c = await html2canvas(pages[i], { scale: 2, useCORS: true, backgroundColor: '#fff', logging: false });
          if (i > 0) pdf.addPage();
          pdf.addImage(c.toDataURL('image/png'), 'PNG', 0, 0, 210, 297);
        }
        pdf.save('signed-document.pdf');
      } catch (e) {
        console.error(e); alert('导出失败，请检查网络\n' + e.message);
      } finally {
        btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = '📄 导出PDF';
      }
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```
